name: components/landing-hero
description: A responsive landing header with a three-zone desktop layout and a mobile slide-over menu. LandingHero composes a left brand block, centered navigation, and right-side primary/secondary action groups. On mobile, primary actions remain visible while navigation and secondary actions collapse into an animated right-side drawer with overlay, keyboard escape handling, and close interactions.
useCases: SaaS landing pages that need a reusable top hero/header with desktop and mobile parity
Marketing sites that keep primary CTA actions visible while collapsing secondary actions into mobile menu
Product websites requiring configurable nav items with optional nested links
Design systems that need a slot-based brand/nav/actions header primitive
